extraction.Name: Lillie Tobacco
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent in fee for her land for she knew she could not pay the taxes on it but that she took it on the advice of the District Farmer and the clerk in the Office who was giving them out
extraction.Recorded patent: I did not have the patent recorded, but I understand Mr. Pourier did, as I gave it to him when I sold the land
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: sold it to Baptiste Pourier of Manderson, So. Dak, for six cows, six horses and $300.00 in Cash
extraction.Buyer: Baptiste Pourier of Manderson, So. Dak., for six cows, six horses and $300.00 in Cash; horses and cattle were worth at that time about $1000.00, making $1300.00 for the land
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: I could not pay the taxes on my land so I sold it
extraction.Occupation/Income: depends on her husband for support, but all he can do is common labor and a little freighting and it is not enough to live on and keep the children
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent and not in good health; has six small children depending on her for a living; has drawn no rations, received no aid from the Government, County or state since her patent was issued; has nothing, no land and no home; document sworn November 10, 1928; State of South Dakota, County of Shannon
